rules.rule_text:
title: HackTool - GoldenDMSA Execution
id: c41ec561-872d-469b-847c-1653ad19b45d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects execution of GoldenDMSA hacktool used for Directory Service
  Account manipulation.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/Semperis/GoldenDMSA
- https://ipurple.team/2025/09/02/golden-dmsa/
- https://www.semperis.com/blog/golden-dmsa-what-is-dmsa-authentication-bypass/
- https://thehackernews.com/2025/07/critical-golden-dmsa-attack-in-windows.html
- https://hacktricks.wiki/en/windows-hardening/active-directory-methodology/golden-dmsa-gmsa.html
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2026-10-19
tags:
- attack.persistence
- attack.privilege-escalation
- attack.t1098
- attack.credential-access
- attack.t1110.001
- attack.t1558.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: \GoldenDMSA.exe
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - wordlist
    - bruteforce
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - ' -s '
    - S-1-5-21-
    - ' -d '
    - ' -k '
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: high
